<thought>We need to determine the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule, but we have no explicit structure. The available tool carbon_nmr_spectra can provide the 13C NMR data for the current sample, from which we can count signals in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). This will give the number of distinct aromatic carbon environments, which for a typical aromatic ring equals the number of aromatic carbons if all are chemically equivalent or distinct. We'll retrieve the spectra and count the aromatic region peaks.</thought>
